alkylation reagent: free sulfhydryl groups were carbamidomethylated using 30 mM iodoacetamide
cleavage agent: Trypsin (Promega, sequencing grade) was added at a ratio of 1:30
collision energy: subjected to collision induced dissociation in the ion trap with a normalized collision energy of 35%
fractionation method: fractionated using strong cation exchange chromatography (SCX)
fragmentation method: subjected to collision induced dissociation in the ion trap
instrument: performed on an LTQ-Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer
labeling: We used stable isotope labeled yeast cultures (SILAC)
reduction reagent: Cysteines were reduced with 10 mM DTT
reduction concentration: Cysteines were reduced with 10 mM DTT
